qa_pairs.question: Which engine types use the cylinder head cover torque specifications shown in this table?
qa_pairs.answer: All engine types for most specifications, with M21 specifically noted for the oil trap connection

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this torque specification table belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11-10 Engine, subsection 11 12 Cylinder Head and Cover

qa_pairs.question: What are the different screw sizes specified for cylinder head cover installation?
qa_pairs.answer: M6, M7, and M8 screws are specified for cylinder head cover installation
